info.title: API.SH: Best Buy
info.description: The Best Buy API from API.SH: public Best Buy data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Shipping and store pickup availability for a SKU near a ZIP code: Best Buy's button state (Add to Cart, Sold Out...), shipping eligibility, and each nearby store with pickup eligibility, distance, in-store quantity and pickup date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bestbuy-availability

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Best Buy SKU (or pass the product `url`).

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: US ZIP code.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product URL instead of `sku`.

parameters.name: best_buy_only
parameters.description: 0: also UPS/FedEx pickup points (default only Best Buy stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A category or browse listing: the products Best Buy shows for a category with SKU, name, brand, price, regular price and savings, rating and review count, condition, image and link, 18 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bestbuy-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Best Buy category id (`abcat0502000` for laptops, `pcmcat...` for sub-categories) or a bestbuy.com category page URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Best Buy product questions and answers
get.description:
The customer questions on a Best Buy product with their answers: question title and text, author, date, answer count, helpful votes, and each answer's text, author, date, votes and badges. 20 questions a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bestbuy-questions

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Best Buy SKU, or use url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: bestbuy.com product link in any form.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default: Best Buy's).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a Best Buy product with sort, star-rating and verified-purchase filters. `summary` holds the average rating, review count, recommended percent, count per star and the pros and cons reviewers mention most. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bestbuy-reviews

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Product URL (instead of sku).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, helpful, relevant, highest or lowest.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Star ratings to include, comma-separated, e.g. 1,2.

parameters.name: verified_purchase
parameters.description: true: verified purchases only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Best Buy product search with sort, price range, minimum rating, condition, category, brand and raw facet filters. `facets` lists the filters the search offers (field, name, values with counts, each with the `qp` string that applies it); `applied_filters` echoes the filters used. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bestbuy-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name(s), comma-separated (Best Buy brand facet).

parameters.name: qp
parameters.description: Raw Best Buy facet filter as in bestbuy.com search URLs, e.g. currentprice_facet=Price~$100 - $149.99 (several joined with ^).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: best_match (default), best_selling, best_discount, price_asc, price_desc, rating (customer rating) or newest (new arrivals).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in US dollars.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in US dollars.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum customer rating, 1-5 (5: five stars only; otherwise that many stars and up).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma-separated: new, refurbished.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Best Buy category id to narrow the results to, e.g. pcmcat287600050003 (see `facets` for the ids a search offers).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
